name: validate_skill
description: Validate a skill definition without saving anything. Pass the exact arguments you intend to give save_skill; returns valid plus warnings, or an error listing every problem. Checks package paths and `from` import sources, but not target conflicts (an existing file or package at the target, `overwrite=false`), which `save_skill` reports itself.

description.description: Short summary shown in skill lists and matching.

prompt.description: Full skill prompt body (Markdown) to validate.

tools.description: Explicit tool names that the skill is allowed to use.

tool_groups.description: Tool groups that the skill is allowed to use (e.g. builtin, executor).

mcp_servers.description: Required MCP server names needed to run this skill.

resources.description: Optional bundled resources. Each entry has `path` and exactly one of `content`, `content_base64`, or `from` (same shape as save_skill).

subskills.description: Optional nested sub-skills, each with `name` and `prompt`; may also include `resources` with the same shape as the top-level field.
